ignoreRules.note: Existing .data/.tools/.vercel/node_modules/.env.local are covered. .aws/.ssh/generic credential/PEM paths are not covered by root ignore; no such current or historical paths were found unless separately listed. No ignore change was made.

publicationScope.source: Tracked/current application, packages, scripts, infra and public config after reported privacy review; exclude .data/.tools/.vercel/node_modules/.env/ledger/logs/credentials and generated release packet.
publicationScope.documentation: README, runbooks, public planning, proposed root original-code MIT license and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES after root review; preserve upstream supplied licenses. No original-code license file was created by this audit.
publicationScope.evidence: Select sanitized public chain receipts, candidate/source hashes, tests and screenshots; review operator contacts and local absolute path fields before staging. Recorded failed/interrupted evidence must remain accurately labeled; no automatic rewriting of historical records.
publicationScope.providerSecurity: Project/service/deployment IDs and canonical public TEST addresses are operational identifiers, not credential token findings; their publication audience remains the root decision.
publicationScope.history: Root authorized preservation/publication of the seven-commit provenance, including live35f source. Generic development paths are listed as portability/hygiene notes; placeholder author contacts and deliberately public fixtures are classified without publishing private values.

limitations: Heuristic pattern scanning is not proof of absence of every secret or opaque credential format; no known private values were read or compared.

All binary blobs/files are hashed and scanned for detectable raw patterns; images/PDFs were not visually/OCR audited (ASCII85/Flate PDF streams were additionally decoded and scanned), and this is not a complete binary semantic or steganographic review.
Git LFS remote storage, submodule repositories, external user/provider credential stores and provider/build logs were not scanned.
Current nonignored files can change while other authorized agents work; inventories bind the exact bytes observed, not future commits/staging.
Private operator contacts and local-machine path matches are intentional public-hygiene findings; no historical evidence was automatically scrubbed.
Root must resolve intended public commit-author identity, add the authorized original-code license and review staging/account destination before any public push.
